title: Create Number Request
description: Request model for requesting new phone numbers.

companyProfileGuid.description: Unique identifier of the company profile that will be operating the requested numbers.

quantity.description: The quantity of numbers to be requested.

rangeSize.description:
The size of the range to be requested. **Only required if a range of numbers is requested.
Requires number ranges to be supported. See the order restrictions endpoint for the allowed ranges**

areaCode.description:
The area code to request numbers for. Required when city is not provided.
If the city is also provided, this will be used in combination with city.

city.description:
City to request numbers for. Required when area code is not provided.
If the area code is also provided, this will be used in combination with area code.

region.description: Region to request numbers for. Only required for NANPA.

comment.description: Additional comment for customers to for example add a distribution group or IP address.

callbackUrl.description: URL that we'll send a POST request to when the status of the request has been updated. The body of this post request will contain the entire number request order including the updated status.
